text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. I will change my plans and use this time to rest."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Where is this?
I was supposed to be sleeping in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san,
shall we head to the gym soon?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Class?
What time is it right now—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No way... There's no clock in this classroom!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Could it be, the clock is...
No, does the concept of time not even exist here...?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No...
How am I supposed to live in a world like this...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No... if there isn't a clock,
shouldn't I just... become the clock myself?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, the sun is out. If I read the numbers using it like a sundial...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I should be able to... invent the very concept of time itself!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Thank goodness. It was just a dream...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, even without a clock, we managed to get along
surprisingly well, didn't we? ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash felt right back in top shape
thanks to the delightful dream.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san,
class is about to start, you know?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "But when does it start? Please... please tell me what time...!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Albtraum...
I feel like I haven't rested at all... *sigh*
